_comment: DRAFT, written by Claude 2026-10-14 (board #8202) and not lore. Maps each of the fourteen climate zones of worldgen/climate.py to the set of #3676 agro-climate class ids that zone makes physically plausible. Read by tabulate_state_prior.py only to fill the non-blocking clim_expected / clim_disagree columns; it assigns no state a class. Real-world-equivalent economics (testing.md, 2026-10-12) supersedes the climate classes for starting values, so treat this as a physical prior and QA aid. highland_alpine appears where altitude can override a zone; a state with phys_highland is never flagged.

Af.why: year-round rain at low latitude is rainforest

Am.why: monsoon forest grading to savanna where the dry season lengthens

Aw.why: savanna; the wetter margin carries forest

BWh.why: hot desert; a canon river makes a river-valley desert

BWk.why: cold desert: rain-shadow plateaus and basins, steppe on the wet edge

BSh.why: hot semi-arid sits between savanna and desert

BSk.why: cold semi-arid is steppe; the dry edge reads as desert

Cs.why: dry-summer mild climate is the Mediterranean class

Cfa.why: warm humid temperate; the dry-summer margin shades to Mediterranean

Df.why: humid continental: the warm side is temperate, the cold side boreal, the dry interior steppe

Dc.why: subarctic taiga; a cold coast reads as arctic-boreal coast

ET.why: tundra: arctic coast, the forest edge, or alpine ground

EF.why: ice cap: nothing farmable; the nearest classes are the arctic coast and alpine
